title: Herd-first Actions deploy
summary: No changes you will notice in day-to-day use. This release updates how the intranet is checked and deployed behind the scenes.

changed: Deploys of published release tags now run through GitHub Actions, with a health check afterwards.
Local accessibility checks stay on Laravel Herd and the Cursor browser; Playwright is no longer used for CI or local a11y.

internal_notes: Epic #363 (already closed). Shipped #364 Actions Cloudron deploy workflow; #365 remove Playwright from CI and local a11y. Close-out only: release note, tag, GitHub release, deploy, close milestone 32.
